async def run(groups, read):
    for batch in groups:
        # ruleid: await-in-loop-python
        await asyncio.gather(*(read(item, validate=True) for item in batch))
    for batch in groups:
        # ruleid: await-in-loop-python
        rows = await asyncio.gather(*(read(item) for item in batch), return_exceptions=True)
    for batch in groups:
        # ruleid: await-in-loop-python
        await asyncio.gather(*[read(item) for item in batch])
    for batch in groups:
        # ruleid: await-in-loop-python
        await asyncio.gather(*(read(item, session) for item in batch), audit())
    for batch in groups:
        # ruleid: await-in-loop-python
        await prepare(batch)
        # ruleid: await-in-loop-python
        await asyncio.gather(*[read(item) for item in batch])
    for batch in groups:
        # ruleid: await-in-loop-python
        await asyncio.gather(*[read(item) for item in other])
    for item in items:
        # ruleid: await-in-loop-python
        await asyncio.gather(read(item), notify(item))
